items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Do you know, we battled until two o'clock in the afternoon, two or three o'clock in the afternoon?

ctx.x: went to the bar and had my taste, and then I had another taste, so I could carry one up on the bandstand with me. So the girl was sitting up there with her long dress on, holding the trumpet, you know, and ...(?)>.. I was tuning my horn up, you know. So I said, "Where's the trumpet player?" She said, "I'm the trumpet player." I said, "Shit..." -- to myself, you know. So the guys come up, and we all spoke, you know. Well, nobody said anything. So I see her still holding the horn, and I say, "Now, this is going to…
Oh, she was still around that recently.
